sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO EAI.IF_SEM_GR A USING ( SELECT #MBLNR# AS MBLNR, #ZEILE# AS ZEILE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND B.MBLNR = A.MBLNR AND B.ZEILE = A.ZEILE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LOEKZ = #LOEKZ#, BUKRS = #BUKRS#, DIVISION = #DIVISION#, ZSECTCD = #ZSECTCD#, LTEXT = #LTEXT#, MJAHR = #MJAHR#, EBELN = #EBELN#, EBELP = #EBELP#, MATNR = #MATNR#, MAKTX = #MAKTX#, SPEC = #SPEC#, MENGE = #MENGE#, MEINS = #MEINS#, NETPR = #NETPR#, WAERS = #WAERS#, DMBTR = #DMBTR#, ZBUDAT = #ZBUDAT#, LFBNR = #LFBNR#, IF_FLAG = 'N' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LOEKZ, BUKRS, DIVISION, ZSECTCD, LTEXT, MJAHR, MBLNR, ZEILE, EBELN, EBELP, MATNR, MAKTX, SPEC, MENGE, MEINS, NETPR, WAERS, DMBTR, ZBUDAT, LFBNR, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #LOEKZ#, #BUKRS#, #DIVISION#, #ZSECTCD#, #LTEXT#, #MJAHR#, #MBLNR#, #ZEILE#, #EBELN#, #EBELP#, #MATNR#, #MAKTX#, #SPEC#, #MENGE#, #MEINS#, #NETPR#, #WAERS#, #DMBTR#, #ZBUDAT#, #LFBNR#, 'N' )
